glosses: lawn (ground (generally in front of or around a house) covered with grass kept closely mown)

examples.text: Eu olhei para o gramado novamente.
examples.en: I looked at the lawn again.
The lawn needs to be watered.

examples.text: Minha mãe me disse que aparasse o gramado.
examples.en: My mother told me to mow the lawn.

examples.text: Ela o xingou por não cortar o gramado.
examples.en: She scolded him for not mowing the lawn.
